description:
Continuing our series In the Flow, we sat down with filmmaker https://www.youtube.com/user/hashemalghaili to break down his prompting structure. Thanks https://www.youtube.com/user/hashemalghaili for the partnership!

Camera motion → character/scene setup → dialogue
Visual control for creators like Hashem is vital, which is why we added dedicated camera motion and position features directly in Flow.

Over the coming weeks, we're sharing unique workflows and tips from more creators pushing their boundaries. Make sure to follow so you don't miss the next episode!

Try Flow for yourself: https://flow.google  
Learn how to create in Flow: https://youtu.be/9nVEfjmDlVk?si=DKlab6LdBgjaOCX4 
See our Flow playlist on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL590L5WQmH8cZy80Ko7dzpH2MyvNJFE-p&si=JziPldokD6tevISg
